candidate_selection.primary_choice_rationale: The Batch 02 shortlist is the tag-aware scalar coercion family of RPG.GameCore.DynamicValue plus three structurally distinct tag/payload predicates and the raw tag accessor.  Every ACCEPT body is <= 40 instructions, has <= 2 direct callees, reads only the input cell, writes no battle state, and the only deeper callees are error/log or one-time IL2CPP init helpers that do not affect the returned value.

representation_conflicts.native_behavior: get_IsArray/get_IsMap return false when tag matches but the payload pointer is null
representation_conflicts.canonical_behavior: DynamicValue ARRAY/MAP require a non-null ObjectRef; null payload is rejected at the representation boundary
representation_conflicts.analysis: For every representable input the native and canonical results agree; the unreachable native null-payload case is kept as a defensive runtime check.  No representation change is justified yet.
